questions.question: A man deposits ₹2,720 at 15% rate of simple interest per annum. The total amount (in ₹) he will get at the end of 14 years is:

In a river, water is flowing with a speed of 12 km/hr. A motor boat takes equal time in going 85 km downstream and 34 km upstream. How much time will it take to cover 48 km downstream and 84 km upstream?

questions.question: Reyan can do a piece of work in 24 days and Mayank can do the same work in 72 days. Mayank works alone for 2 days and Reyan works alone on the 3rd day. This process continues till the work is completed. In how many days will the work be completed?
